boardMoveNoticeBody: Automations here used to create a card on the kanban when they ran. They still run, but their reports now live with the automation; open one to read what it found. Cards already on the board are unaffected.
boardMoveNoticeTitle: Automation runs no longer appear on the board
completeRequiredFields: Complete the required automation fields before saving.
contextBetweenRunsConcurrencyLock: Locked to 1 while every run uses one shared task.
contextBetweenRunsNewTaskDescription: Each run starts with its own conversation and files. Runs can overlap.
contextBetweenRunsReuseThreadDescription: Every run continues the same task and its files, whatever triggered it. Runs execute one at a time.
contextBetweenRunsReuseThreadPRDescripti: Every run continues the same task, whatever triggered it, so different pull requests share one conversation and files. Runs execute one at a time.
contextBetweenRunsReusePerPRDescription: Runs for the same pull request continue its task. Different pull requests never share a task and can run in parallel.
prContinuationStepHelp: Kandev moves the task to this step before sending the follow-up. The step's own auto-start prompt does not run.
prEndActionDeleteWarning: Deleting removes the task's conversation and files when the pull request ends. Choose Archive task to keep them.
followUpPromptHelp: Sent when a run continues the pull request's task. Leave empty to send the instructions above.
couldNotRefreshRuns: Could not refresh runs; restored from local cache
deleteAutomationDescription: This will permanently delete {{name}}. This action cannot be undone.
deleteAllRunsDescription: This will permanently remove all run records for this automation; including any not currently loaded; and their associated tasks. This cannot be undone.
deleteAllRunsScopedDescription: This will permanently remove the {{status}} runs shown in this view and their associated tasks. This cannot be undone.
emptyListBody: Automations run on a schedule or a webhook and write back what they found. Set one up and its reports land here.
emptyListTitle: No automations in this workspace yet
emptyRunsTitle: No automation has reported in yet
hasNotRunYet: This automation has not run yet.
interpretedAsUtcSetTimezone: interpreted as UTC, set a timezone
listDescription: Create rules that automatically trigger agent tasks.
nameHelp: Enter an automation name to enable saving.
noConversationForRun: This run produced no conversation to read.
noSchedule: No schedule; this automation won't run on its own.
prMergedDeadConfigWarning: No repositories selected; this trigger will not fire. Enable 'All repositories' or add at least one repository.
prEventOpenedTooltip: Fires once when a new open PR is detected. Each PR number is deduped; the same PR won't trigger again.
prEventNewCommitsTooltip: Fires once for each new head commit on an open PR. PRs that were already open are not reviewed until their next push.
prEventReviewRequestedTooltip: Fires when a matching reviewer is requested on an open PR, including a re-request after an earlier review.
prQuietPeriodHelp: New commits fire only after the PR head stays unchanged this long. Use 0 to fire on the next check.
prReviewersHelp: User logins or org/team names. Leave empty to react to any reviewer.
prIncludeExistingLabel: Also run on pull requests already open
prIncludeExistingHelp: Runs once for each matching pull request that was open before this trigger was created. Otherwise only pull requests opened later run.
prTriggerRepositoryHelp: PR triggers always use the PR's own repository.
pushTriggerHelp: Triggers when code is pushed to matching branches
repositoryModeDescription: Add one or more repository and base branch pairs, or run with no repository.
repositoryModeNoneDescription: Run without repository files in a task-owned scratch workspace.
runReasonDedupUnresolved: Duplicate check did not resolve a value for this delivery
runReasonRepositoryContinuationReused: Repository inherited from the continued task
runReasonRepositoryLoadFailed: Repository selection could not be verified
runReasonRepositoryNoneConfigured: No repository is configured for this automation
runReasonSelectorAmbiguous: Repository selector matched more than one repository: {{value}}
runReasonSelectorNoMatch: Repository selector matched no configured repository: {{value}}
runReasonSelectorUnresolved: Repository selector did not resolve a value for this delivery
samplePayloadHelp: Paste an example JSON body to discover available placeholders.
schedulePollingHelp: Checked every 30 seconds by a background process. Schedules persist across backend restarts.
schedulerNote: Scheduled automations only run while kandev is running. A firing missed while it was closed runs once on the next tick, not once per missed occurrence.
taskTitleHelp: Leave empty to use the default. Supports placeholders.
taskModeAutomationRunDescription: Each run gets a private task that does not appear in Kanban or the sidebar.
taskModeNormalTaskDescription: Each run's task appears in the selected workflow, in Kanban and the sidebar.
normalTaskWorkflowHelp: Choose a workflow so this task appears in Kanban and the sidebar.
triggerInfoGithubPr: Checks GitHub about once a minute for PRs matching your filters, independent of any schedule.
triggerInfoGithubPrMerged: Fires when Kandev's PR poller detects that a linked PR has been merged. Detection can lag by up to a minute.
triggerInfoScheduled: Checked every 30 seconds. Fires when the cron schedule matches.
triggerInfoWebhook: Fires immediately when a POST request hits the webhook URL.
webhookCreatedDescription: Configure your external system to POST to this URL with the secret in the <0>{{header}}</0> header. You can come back to this automation any time to copy these values again.
webhookDedupKeyHelp: A dot path into the payload, for example issue.id. A delivery whose resolved value repeats an earlier firing's is recorded as a duplicate and does not create a new task. Leave blank to fire on every delivery.
webhookFiltersHelp: Every filter must pass for a delivery to fire. A rejected delivery returns success, creates no task, and is recorded as skipped.
webhookRepositorySelectorHelp: A dot path into the payload whose resolved value is matched exactly against a configured repository's name. Leave blank to use the automation's configured repository as before.
webhookUrlAfterSave: Webhook URL will be available after saving the automation.
webhookUsageHelp: Send a POST request with a JSON body and the secret in the <0>{{header}}</0> header. Reference fields from the payload with <1>{{placeholder}}</1>, e.g. <2>{{example}}</2>.
whenDescription: What causes this automation to run
repeatRunsDescription: How runs relate to each other
instructionsDescription: What the agent is asked to do
agentDescription: Who does the work, where, and with which tools
scheduleUnparseable: That's not a schedule we can read. Try a 5-field cron like 0 9 * * 1-5.
nextFiringConcurrencyPaused: Paused - a run is still open (max {{max}} at a time)
nextFiringNoSchedule: No schedule - only runs when you trigger it
nextFiringSwitchedOff: Switched off - it will not fire
pluginWebhookHelp: Save the condition, then configure its webhook. Reconfigure after changing filters. Rotation immediately invalidates the old signing secret.
pluginWebhookUnavailable: This plugin condition is unavailable. Check the plugin and workspace connection.
pluginWebhookError: The webhook operation failed. Check the saved condition and plugin connection.
managedConversationModeDescription: Each run sends its prompt to an existing plugin conversation.
managedDestinationEmpty: No managed conversations are available in this workspace.
managedDestinationUnavailable: This destination is unavailable. Select an available conversation to repair it.
managedDestinationApprovalRequired: Workspace approval is required before this conversation can receive automation inputs.
managedDestinationPluginUnavailable: The plugin is unavailable. Enable or reinstall it to resume delivery.
managedDestinationPausedHelp: The conversation is paused. Scheduled inputs will wait until it resumes.
thenManagedConversationDescription: Each scheduled run sends one input to the selected plugin conversation.
importManagedSchedulesDescription: Choose a Kandev automation YAML file. Select a conversation in this workspace for each imported schedule before it is created.
importInvalidDocument: This file is not a valid Kandev automation YAML document.
importNoManagedSchedules: This file does not contain a managed-conversation schedule.
importInvalidSchedule: A managed schedule is missing a supported scheduled trigger or destination.
importSkippedOtherModes_one: {{count}} automation with another target mode was skipped.
importSkippedOtherModes_other: {{count}} automations with other target modes were skipped.
retryDisabledDescription: Record the failure and stop after the first attempt.
retryFiniteDescription: Stop after the configured number of additional attempts.
retryInfiniteDescription: Keep retrying until the run succeeds or you stop the automation.
retryMaxHelp: Use a whole number. Infinite mode ignores this value.
retryHistoryHelp: Every attempt lists each retry as its own run. Retry timeline groups them into one entry.
triggerInfoManual: Runs this automation when you trigger it manually.
pluginToolsDescription: Select the tools this automation can use.
pluginToolsLoadError: Could not load plugin tools. The saved selection is unchanged.
pluginToolsEmpty: No installed plugin currently offers tools for private automations.
pluginToolsReviewRequired: Review required: the plugin configuration changed.
pluginToolsReselect: Select tools again and save to restore access.
pluginToolsClearedHint: Save to remove plugin tool access.
mcpNextStart: Changes apply from the next agent start. A continued task keeps its current tools until its agent restarts.
mcpNewTasks: Applies to newly created tasks. Existing tasks keep their own choices.
mcpConfigurationGrant: This package can change authorized workflows, profiles, prompts, executors, and automations. It cannot change MCP access grants.
mcpThirdPartyPermissions: Third-party servers use their own permissions.
mcpOptionsFailed: Could not load MCP choices. Saved choices remain unchanged.
passthroughOutputNotCapturedTitle: CLI passthrough output is not captured in this run's transcript.
passthroughOutputFutureSessionsDescripti: Disable CLI passthrough in the automation's agent profile to record output for future sessions. Previous terminal output cannot be recovered here.
enableScheduleFailed: Couldn't turn on the schedule. Try again.
